verdict.rationale: uv is a command-line package and project manager with no graphical UI. Its whole surface is the documented CLI (uv init, add, lock, tool, python, cache, self update, version --output-format json), so the question of API-versus-UI parity does not apply to it. The 404 OpenAPI probe is irrelevant because there is no UI-backed service whose functions an API would need to mirror.
